title: Handwritten note from a landlord about late rent
source: synthetic (written for this project; organisations and people are fictional)
notes: Hard negative: mentions eviction and rent but is not an LTB notice; the desk may read it, explain that only an official N4 starts the process, and draft a short reply. Synthetic.
summary_en: An informal note from the landlord saying the rent is late, asking for payment by Friday and threatening to 'start eviction' - not an official Landlord and Tenant Board form.
text:
Mariana -
Your rent for September is late again. I need the $1,850 by Friday or I will start eviction. Leave a cheque in my mailbox or e-transfer.
- Dana (landlord)
